name: CycloneReady translation files
schema: Each JSON contains matching en and my objects. Keys are stable translation IDs; values are complete source strings and their Myanmar translations.

coverage.template.json: Shared navigation, authentication, validation, settings, footer, form placeholders, social-link labels, image/logo alternatives and common controls; preserves every original supplied template key.
coverage.home.json: Home page copy, testimonials and their names/roles, image alternatives, carousel accessibility labels and dynamic regional overview strings.
coverage.aboutus.json: About page content, contact form labels/placeholders, source citations, team-member names and image alternatives.
coverage.donate.json: Donation guidance, organisations, contribution methods and interest form.
coverage.historical.json: Historical cyclone timeline, all date labels, impacts, lessons, documentary title and accessibility labels.
coverage.howform.json: Cyclone formation explainer, all stages, image alternatives and explanatory copy.
coverage.reducingcyclonerisks.json: Cyclone risk-reduction guidance and all image alternatives.
coverage.weaffect.json: Human activities and environmental impacts explainer, including image alternatives.
coverage.checklist.json: Checklist page, article copy, numbered section labels, task labels, progress messages, accessible labels and image alternatives.
coverage.cyclone-map.json: Map page, dynamic region data, hazards, local place descriptions, generated map controls, accessibility labels and fallback/error text from map.js.
coverage.simulator.json: Simulator page, stage descriptions (including page/JS spelling variants), status labels, condition feedback, analysis strings and image alternatives.
coverage.vn.json: Decision-making story title screen, ending screen, UI controls, choices, dates, endings and every dialogue line from vn.js.

integration_note: These JSONs provide full bilingual key/value coverage. Static and dynamically generated source text must use the matching keys in the site translation loader or be marked with data-translate attributes for language switching to affect the rendered page.
